routes.//: app.neuromuscular.ca is the shared portal host for every programme. Its root must not serve Toronto's landing page (program.html and the SPA's Landing route are both Citywide-specific), so send it to the sign-in screen. 307 rather than 308: temporary, so browsers do not cache it permanently if this changes.
Every other host (www.neuromuscularto.ca, preview URLs) keeps the existing behaviour: Toronto's public programme page at the root.
